artworks.title: Le bouquet (The Bouquet)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing from the knees up. On the left is a woman in profile facing a man. She has her hair in a bun and wears a dress with a checkered pattern, holding a large envelope. The man on the right wears a suit with a top hat, holding a small piece of paper. The background consists of vertical lines, suggesting a wall, and there is a hint of a basket with coins near the woman. The setting appears simple, with minimal details indicating an indoor environment.

artworks.title: Danseuses dans leur loge (Dancers in Their Dressing Room)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women, both depicted with only their upper bodies visible. The woman on the left stands with her side facing forward, her head turned slightly away, with arms bent at the elbows resting on her hips. She has her hair styled in an updo. She appears to be wearing a corset or similar undergarment, partially wrapped in a loosely draped fabric around her waist. The second woman, seated just behind the first, also only visible from the torso up, leans slightly back, her face angled slightly upwards, giving a clearer view of her facial features, and her hair also styled up. She has a loose robe or garment draped over her shoulders. The surrounding area is sparsely furnished, with what appears to be a table nearby holding small items, such as a bottle and possibly a dish, against a backdrop of vertical lines suggestive of wood paneling. The sketched background remains simple, defined by linework that conveys a sense of space without specific embellishments.

artworks.title: Le café de la Nouvelle Athènes (The Cafe of the New Athens)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a café scene with various patrons. It shows an interior setting with several figures gathered around a table. The lines are sketchy and drawn with ink. One of the elements is a woman in a striped dress facing away from the viewer. Beside her, there are men wearing top hats. On the table, there are glasses and a carafe. The background features linear patterns adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Le bar des Folies-Bergère (The Bar at the Folies-Bergère)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching that shows a group of elegantly dressed men and women in a social scene. The drawing primarily shows their upper bodies, some in full view from the waist up. The people are standing or sitting in a convivial setting, engaging in conversation and interaction. A woman's face is in profile, wearing a straw hat adorned with decorative elements. She is dressed in a fitted jacket and a floor-length plaid skirt, holding a long, thin object. The men are wearing tall top hats and formal attire with detailed coats and jackets. The background is filled with cross-hatching, creating a textured atmosphere indicating an interior space with chairs and tables around. The overall composition depicts a lively and crowded scene of a social gathering.

artworks.title: A Bullier (To Bullier's)
artworks.medium: color etching on wove paper
artworks.description: This print shows two women with their arms linked. The woman on the left is turned towards the right, facing with the other woman. Her facial features are partially visible; she has a sharp nose and an upturned mouth. Her light hair is styled up and covered by a wide-brimmed light blue hat. She wears a red, form-fitting dress. The woman on the right is turned towards the other woman, and more of her face is visible. She has wide, dark eyes and is smiling. Her dark hair is styled up with a yellow hat resting on top. She wears a dress with a high neckline and what appears to be a black-and-white plaid design. Around her waist, there's a dark belt that cinches the outfit. The background behind the women is dark, with light circular shapes resembling streetlamps glowing behind them.

artworks.title: A Bullier (To Bullier's)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women from head to waist standing next to each other, engaged in conversation. The woman on the left is positioned partly in profile, facing the woman on the right, while the woman on the right is turned slightly away, facing towards the left. Their faces are delicately featured, with one woman wearing a decorative hat with feathers and the other with a simpler headpiece. The woman on the left wears a dark blouse, while the woman on the right dons a patterned outfit. Both women have their hair styled up or tucked under their headwear. The background consists of a textured, abstract shading, with lighter areas suggesting sky or cloud formations.

artworks.title: Les Folies-Bergère (planche refusée, 2e planche) (The Folies Bergère) (refused plate, second plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Arches paper
artworks.description: The image shows three people at a small round table in an indoor setting. The woman on the left is sitting with her hands on the table, looking towards the viewer. The woman in the middle faces away, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with decorations. The man on the right stands, wearing a dark suit with a beard, smoking a pipe, and wearing a tall top hat. The background shows a dim café environment with blurred decor elements and another figure wearing hats. A small glass is on the table in front of the seated woman.

artworks.title: L'ambulante au parapluie (Walker with an Umbrella)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a full-length side profile. She has distinct facial features with shadows accentuating her cheekbones, and her hair is styled under a hat adorned with a decorative plume or flower. She wears a long, patterned dress with long sleeves and holds an umbrella under her arm. The background features a heavily hatched and cross-hatched pattern, with a lamp post casting light in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Le Traite des blanches (The White Slave Trade)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is standing with their body slightly turned to the right, looking downward, with long, flowing hair that drapes over their shoulders. The person on the right is facing left, wearing glasses and what appears to be a large, ornate hat adorned with feathers. They have a fuller figure, with facial features depicted in profile, and their hair is mostly concealed by the hat. This individual is wearing a shawl or wrap over a dress, and they hold a closed umbrella in front of them. There are no visible items of jewelry on either person. The background is a plain, textured surface with sketch-like vertical lines.

artworks.title: Les couloirs du Palais (The Corridors of the Palace of Justice)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of dark figures in an abstract style. The drawing features a central figure that appears to be cloaked with surrounding figures in the background, all depicted through an intricate web of crisscrossing lines. The scene is infused with a sense of movement and mystery, created by the use of black ink on a textured, aged-looking paper. The lines vary in density, contributing to a perception of depth and mass.

artworks.title: Témoins à l'audience (1ère planche) (Evidence at the Hearing) (first plate)
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching (zinc) in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a woman and a child. The woman's upper body is shown, slightly leaning forward, holding the child in her arms. Her head is turned slightly to the right, with loose, curly hair falling around her face and a hat of some sort on her head. Her facial features are softly drawn, with distinctive lines defining her eyes and mouth. She wears an outfit with a pronounced collar and sleeves, with the rest of her attire blending into the impressionistic lines. The child is nestled closely in her arms, partly covered by fabric, with a faint hint of a face peeking through. Behind them, another figure stands tall and cloaked in flowing garments, with hands raised to chest level. The backdrop is minimally detailed, giving a textured appearance that enhances the prominence of the central figures. The sketch is composed of delicate lines against a pale background, creating an ethereal quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Témoins à l'audience (2e planche) (Evidence at the Hearing) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching and soft-ground etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts four individuals - three adults and one child - seated closely together. The adults are arranged in a semi-reclined position, with one appearing to be resting or sleeping and leaning against a seating structure. The child is being held by the adult in the center. Facial features are depicted with soft lines, and the individuals are wearing draped clothing. The surroundings include a bench or seating area, with a textured wall in the background. There are no visible jewelry or distinct objects in the scene.

artworks.title: Témoins à l'audience (2e planche) (Evidence at the Hearing) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching and soft-ground etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a group of people seated, capturing the upper part of their bodies. There are three adults and one child. The facial expressions vary among the individuals. The individuals are dressed in loose-fitting clothes, possibly robes. One adult is holding a large book. The background shows linear patterns suggesting a wall or structure, providing texture.

artworks.title: Danseuse et Maître d'hôtel (Dancer and Headwaiter)
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This print shows a woman and a man standing together. The woman is on the left, bending forward, her torso facing the right and her head turned back towards us. Her facial features are simple, and her dark hair is styled in an updo with what look like white ribbons. She is dressed in a short, flowing dress. Her legs are extended out to either side in a wide stance, and she is wearing ballet shoes. On the right is a man clad in a formal suit, with a dark jacket over a light shirt. He is leaning slightly forward, turned towards the woman, his hands clasped together. He appears to have a white cloth draped over one arm. The background is gray, with some small white marks around the people.

artworks.title: Après la saisie (After the Seizure)
artworks.medium: etching (zinc) on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image displays four figures walking together: two adults and two children. They appear to be mid-stride, moving from left to right across the image. The adult on the right, a woman with her face partially obscured by a headscarf, is looking downward. She wears a long, flowing garment and is leaning slightly forward. The child to her right is holding her hand and is wearing a hat and a coat. To the left is another child, facing slightly forward. Behind this child is an adult figure in a hooded coat. The background depicts a winter landscape with faint outlines of buildings and fences. The image has a monochromatic tone, emphasizing the starkness of the scene.

artworks.title: Après la saisie (After the Seizure)
artworks.medium: etching (zinc) on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting four figures walking closely together. The figures include an adult man, an adult woman, and two young children. The man wears a hat and coat, while the woman wears a headscarf and a long dress. The children are dressed in warm clothing. They are portrayed on uneven ground, with buildings in the background. The figures are shown from head to toe, with their bodies slightly turned to the left. The man's facial features are shadowed, the woman's features are delicate lines, and the children's faces are round with soft features.

artworks.title: Fille-mère (1ère planche) (Unwed Mother) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of five figures positioned in various poses around a table or flat surface. The central figure appears slumped over the surface, with another figure supporting them to the right. To the left, another figure rests a hand under their chin, while two figures stand or lean against a higher surface in the background, one with long hair covering their face. The figures are drawn with expressive lines, conveying weight and emotion. The background is simple, emphasizing the focus on the figures.

artworks.title: Le gros cigare (The Big Cigar)
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching and drypoint (zinc plate) on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a sketched style. The person on the left appears from the waist up, slightly leaning forward towards the other person. They have closed eyes, parted lips, and voluminous, upward and outward styled hair. Their attire includes a garment with zigzag or geometric designs. The person on the right is shown from the shoulders up, facing the first person in a side profile. They have a prominent nose, an open mouth, and groomed short hair. The background is a textured, lightly colored surface, emphasizing the two figures.

artworks.title: Baignoire au théatre (Lower Box at the Theater)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint (zinc plate) on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows three people from the shoulders up, sitting closely together. The person on the left has voluminous wavy hair, the one in the center has tightly drawn back or styled hair, and the person on the right has light facial features defined by long, slanting lines. Their clothing is closely fitting with textured lines suggesting fabric folds. The background appears to be indoors, with suggestive lines indicating a crowd or busy space. Above to the left are further indistinct forms, potentially suggesting spectators or an audience.

artworks.title: Femme nue, assise sur son lit, de face (Nude Woman, Seated on Her Bed, Front View)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint (zinc plate) on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a bed. She is positioned with her body facing slightly to her left, her upper body supported by her left hand while her right hand rests on her knee. Her head is turned toward the viewer, and she has a slight smile. The woman has medium-length hair pulled up into a bun on top of her head. There are no clothes or jewelry. She sits on a bed with loosely draped sheets. The background consists of simple, minimal lines suggesting the continuation of the bed's surface and possibly a bedpost.

artworks.title: Le retour de l'enfant prodigue (3e planche) (The Return of the Prodigal Son) (third plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people in an intimate position. One person is kneeling while the other is standing, leaning towards the kneeling figure. Both individuals have indistinct facial features due to a sketch-like drawing technique. The standing figure is slightly bent over, with their face leaning towards the other person. Both have short, sketchy hair. The standing person wears a long coat, shaded boldly, while the kneeling figure's clothing is less defined. A hat is in the foreground, and faint outlines of buildings and trees are in the background.

artworks.title: Le bon samaritain (The Good Samaritan)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing that shows a lion attacking a reclining figure along with abstract lines indicating motion or action. The composition includes dynamic lines creating a sense of movement. A dark mass on the left represents the lion, depicted with intense strokes suggesting fur and form. The right side shows the contours of a figure, possibly a fallen victim, with less detail. The background has flowing lines that could symbolize wind or atmosphere, enhancing the dramatic tension. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette to emphasize the scene's starkness and drama.

artworks.title: La sortie de l'audience (1ère planche) (Coming Out of the Hearing) (first plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with several figures portrayed as outlines. The central focus is a woman and two children. The woman is slightly bent forward, wearing a shawl covering her head. One child wears a hat and coat, holding a small object. The other child wears a wide-brimmed hat and knee-length coat. In the background, there are two adult figures, with one looking downwards and the other wearing a long garment and headwear. The setting is sparsely detailed, suggesting an undefined interior space. No jewelry or additional objects are shown.

artworks.title: La sortie de l'audience (1ère planche) (Coming Out of the Hearing) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures gathered around a table or bench. At the center is a prominent figure standing over what appears to be an elevated platform. The use of light and shading created by fine lines gives depth and texture to the drawing. Some figures in the foreground appear seated, and there is a sense of interaction between the figures, suggested by their stances and gestures. The scene evokes a serious and contemplative atmosphere.
